Teleon · the descent, on whole loops

Watch the loop descend.

Every operational AI loop — research, extraction, browser-use, support, coding — starts unbounded (a frontier model on every step, max iterations, no caching) and we descend it to the bounded path: the cheapest tool plane per step, early-stop when there's no new progress, the LLM reserved for supervision. Across 15 loops that's ~96.2% cheaper — while the loop still completes.

Figures computed from architecture/agentic_loop_catalog.json (representative). serves_truth=false.
